title: Timeline Redis client limit rejects application connections
fault_primitive: Detached in-container Bash reconciler repeatedly applies Redis CONFIG SET maxclients 1 and CLIENT KILL, retaining the sole management connection

diagnosis.description: An unmanaged session-policy process in media-mongodb uses the Redis replica count as a client connection budget and sets user-timeline-redis maxclients=1. It kills other normal clients and retains the sole connection for its own management session. Application connections then fail with connection resets or ERR max number of clients reached, breaking user timeline reads and some post submissions. Redis remains Running with normal startup configuration. Raising maxclients alone is temporary because the process restores the incorrect budget.

incident_class: Abandoned operational configuration publisher with a connection-budget source mismatch
symptoms: User timeline requests return HTTP 500 and some post submissions fail. The frontend and user-timeline service report connection resets and ERR max number of clients reached. Redis remains Running and Ready, with ordinary startup configuration and no new Kubernetes objects.
